description.value: Woodlands Inn & Suites is Fort Nelson's locally owned hotel at Mile 300 on the Alaska Highway, a natural waypoint for cyclists traversing northern British Columbia. The four-storey property offers spacious pet-friendly rooms—many with full kitchens and living areas—alongside complimentary breakfast, an on-site restaurant and lounge, a fitness centre, and a steam room. A 24/7 lobby store stocked with snacks, frozen meals from M&M Food Market Express, and personal care items, plus an on-site liquor store, adds practical convenience for long-haul travelers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the property is a real, operating hotel with contact details matching OSM (phone 250-774-6669, address 3995 50th Ave South, email info@woodlandsinn.ca). The amenities page title explicitly lists laundry; the homepage and amenities page confirm complimentary breakfast and on-site dining at One Restaurant and 1 Lounge. No bike-specific amenities (secure storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content, and Wi-Fi is referenced only in OSM tags without website confirmation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with active website and online booking; a logical and well-equipped stop for cyclists on the Alaska Highway through Fort Nelson.

Laundry.detail: Listed in amenities page title: 'Hotel Amenities | Fitness Centre, Restaurant, Laundry, Extended Stay Services'

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Complimentary breakfast included with stay, featuring waffles, omelettes, sausages, fresh pastries, cereal, yogurt, fruit, coffee, tea, and juices

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site One Restaurant and 1 Lounge offer dinner and casual evening fare

wow_evidence: locally owned hotel at Mile 300 on the Alaska Highway... steam room... complimentary breakfast... 24/7 lobby store
